extracted.name: Southwestern Chopped Chicken Salad
extracted.description: This flavor and texture-packed Southwestern Chopped Chicken Salad comes together in minutes and you can get started on it the day before.
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt (we use nonfat)
2 heaping teaspoons taco seasoning (we use mild)
salt, to taste and if needed
instruction_lines: Add all of the salad ingredients to a large bowl. (If you’re not serving it right away, add the tortilla chips on last right before serving. They’ll stay crunchy that way.)
Whisk the dressing ingredients together, except for the salt. Taste, then add salt to your preference.
Spoon dressing over salad, then toss to combine. Serve cold.
